description: This file defines the interface for Ethernet switch hardware abstraction layer (HAL) functions, including initialization, port status/configuration, MAC address location, and WAN interface controls. It provides function prototypes for interacting with Ethernet switch hardware components.

methods.name: ssp_ethsw_stub_hal_Init
methods.description: Initializes the Ethernet switch hardware abstraction layer.

methods.name: ssp_ethsw_stub_hal_GetAdminPortStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the administrative port status for a specified port.

methods.name: ssp_ethsw_stub_hal_GetPortCfg
methods.description: Gets the configuration for a specified port, including duplex mode and bit rate.

methods.name: ssp_ethsw_stub_hal_GetPort_Status
methods.description: Retrieves the link status, bit rate, and duplex mode for a port.

methods.name: ssp_ethsw_stub_hal_LocatePort_By_MacAddress
methods.description: Locates a port based on its MAC address.

methods.name: ssp_ethsw_stub_hal_SetPortCfg
methods.description: Sets the configuration parameters for a port.

methods.name: ssp_ethsw_stub_hal_SetPortAdminStatus
methods.description: Sets the administrative status of a port.

methods.name: ssp_ethsw_stub_hal_SetAgingSpeed
methods.description: Sets the aging speed for the switch.

methods.name: ssp_ethsw_stub_hal_Get_AssociatedDevice
methods.description: Gets the devices associated with the switch.

methods.name: ssp_ethsw_stub_hal_Get_EthWanInterfaceName
methods.description: Retrieves the Ethernet WAN interface name.

methods.name: ssp_ethsw_stub_hal_Get_EthWanEnable
methods.description: Checks if Ethernet WAN is enabled.

methods.name: ssp_ethsw_stub_hal_Get_EthWanPort
methods.description: Retrieves the Ethernet WAN port number.

methods.name: ssp_ethsw_stub_hal_Set_EthWanPort
methods.description: Sets the Ethernet WAN port number.

methods.name: ssp_ethsw_stub_hal_Get_EthWanLinkStatus
methods.description: Checks the link status of Ethernet WAN.
